description: This file defines the RawFilter class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for handling the 'raw' filter in Twig templates. It extends the FilterExpression class and primarily implements the 'compile' method to generate code for rendering the 'raw' filter.

classes.name: RawFilter
classes.description: A class representing the 'raw' filter in Twig, extending FilterExpression to handle rendering of raw output.
